[[Spearhead Peak]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | skill trainer = y | storage = y }} This is a small outpost in the center of the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]], found to the northeast of [[Droknar's Forge]]. {{Quotation|game| Through an unfortunate twist of heritage, [[Orto Copperhammer]] shared ownership of these mines with a cousin, [[Brag]], a [[Stone Summit]] warlord. When Brag learned that Ortho{{sic}} had trade agreements with the human settlements in the foothills, he led a raid on the mines to punish his cousin. Today this area serves as an outpost for adventurers on their way to the [[Frozen Forest]]. }} ==Getting there== To get here the player must go from Droknar's Forge, through [[Talus Chute]], [[Icedome]], and [[Frozen Forest]]. As an alternative one can go from Droknar's Forge through Talus Chute, [[Camp Rankor]], [[Snake Dance]], [[Grenth's Footprint]], and [[Spearhead Peak]]. It is also possible to travel directly west from [[Iron Mines of Moladune (outpost)|Iron Mines of Moladune]]. ==NPCs== ===Services=== * [[Kavan]] ([[merchant]]) * [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage]]) * [[Gammel]] ([[skill trainer]]) ===Henchmen=== *{{w}} 20 [[Little Thom]] (Brawler) *{{w}} 20 [[Stefan]] (Fighter) *{{r}} 20 [[Reyna]] (Archer) *{{mo}} 20 [[Alesia]] (Healer) *{{mo}} 20 [[Lina]] (Protector) *{{n}} 20 [[Claude]] (Cultist) *{{me}} 20 [[Dunham]] (Enchanter) *{{e}} 20 [[Orion]] (Mage) ==Notes== * This outpost adds less than .10% to the Explorer value for the Southern Shiverpeaks {{gw2w|Copperhammer Mines}} {{Towns and outposts in the Southern Shiverpeaks}}
